red_missing.pro


Routines

top source red_missing

SST pipeline

red_missing, image [, image_out=array] [, indx_data=array] [, indx_missing=array] [, /inplace] [, missing_value=number] [, missing_type_wanted=string] [, missing_type_used=string], ndata=ndata, nmissing=nmissing, verbose=verbose

Find pixels with missing data and optionally set them to NaN, median(), or a given value.

Parameters

image in type=string

The image.

Keywords

image_out out optional type=array

The image, with the missing data set to the value indicated by missing_type_used.

indx_data out optional type=array

Indices of pixels identified as data.

indx_missing out optional type=array

Indices of pixels identified as missing data.

inplace in optional type=boolean

Change the padding inplace in the input image.

missing_value in optional type=number

The value to set missing-data pixels to. If given, missing_type_wanted is ignored.

missing_type_wanted in optional type=string default=opposite

What type of value to set missing-data pixels to. One of 'nan' and 'median'. By default, set it to the opposite of what it appears to be in the input image.

missing_type_used out optional type=string

The type of value missing-data pixels were set to. One of 'nan', 'median' or 'value' (the latter if missing_value was used).

ndata
nmissing
verbose
